deviations.what: t7's live check on tester#5 (dispatch run-30ab94e4, review run-f3776c74): agent_claude, handoff_export_claude (as culture-claude-fixer), handoff_import_claude and the gate passed, but review_qwen ended permission_blocked (Qwen asked to run a shell command in plan mode; the bridge answers permission requests 'cancelled'), so the verdict was review_invalid and nothing was pushed. Level 1 is set back to enabled=false (fixer_levels v3). Fix: the reviewer brief tells the reviewer to read and search rather than run commands, and the qwen bridge removes the shell tool from plan-mode (reviewer) sessions; then t7 is re-run.
deviations.reason: Operator, 2026-10-12: 'Turn level 1 off (Recommended)' after the first live try. Qwen Code 0.25.0 maps an ACP 'cancelled' answer and its only reject option ('cancel', kind reject_once) to the same outcome, so a different answer cannot help. Operator then confirmed both guards: a line in the review brief, and the cultureagent qwen bridge starting a plan-mode session with --exclude-tools run_shell_command.
